lessons.title: One value, one owner
lessons.concept: Read a move error, then repair it
body: A String owns heap-allocated text. Assigning it to another binding moves ownership; it does not copy the text. Using the old binding after that move produces E0382.
First, make the compiler show you that error. Then repair the program with clone(), which creates an independent copy. Later, borrowing lets you share access without copying.
lessons.task: Use clone() when assigning other, so both strings can print their length.
lessons.hint: Use let other = text.clone(); to keep text available.

diagnostic.title: Meet E0382
diagnostic.task: Remove .clone() from the assignment to move the String. Run it and look for E0382. A compile error is the goal of this step.
diagnostic.hint: Change let other = text.clone(); to let other = text;
